summary: 54-year-old local snowboarder caught in an avalanche near the top of Third Bowl on Snodgrass Mountain and suffered a broken femur; Crested Butte Search and Rescue evacuated him in a toboggan through difficult terrain after dark to a waiting ambulance.
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Gunnison Dispatch; Crested Butte Mountain Resort ski patrol
notes: Call received just before 4 p.m.; patient transferred to ambulance about 8:30 p.m.; victim's name not released. Story published 2024-02-14, incident described as 'Saturday afternoon' (2024-02-10 = Saturday, verified).
